title: Linked health records data — Medicines dispensed in primary care (from 1 April 2018)
description: Medicines dispensed in primary care settings in England from 1 April 2018.

BSAPrescriptionID.title: NHS Business Services Authority identification number for a prescription (can be used to identify an item dispensed when used with 'prescription item identification number')

CostCentreODSCode_OFH.title: Code for the organisation that issued the prescription, as taken from the Organisation Data Service (Pseudonymised by OFH)

CostCentreSubType.title: Sub-type of prescribing organisation
CostCentreSubType.$comment: Sparse coding in the dictionary: the listed codes carry labels and other values are allowed (D111).

ItemActualCost.title: Actual cost paid for the dispensed medicine (national average discount for the month+out of pocket+consumables+container allowance)
ItemActualCost.$comment: The source states no range, so none is asserted (D024).

ItemID.title: NHS Business Services Authority identification number for an item on a prescription (can be used to identify an item dispensed when used with 'prescription identification number')
ItemID.$comment: The source states no range, so none is asserted (D024).

ItemNIC.title: The Net Ingredient Cost of the medicine

MaternityExemptionFlag.title: Indicator of whether or not the patient is pregnant, derived from maternity exemption.
MaternityExemptionFlag.description: Data is limited because maternity exemption does not start at the beginning of pregnancy and it continues for 12 months after due date or birth

OutOfHoursIndicator.title: Whether the prescription was Out of Hours
OutOfHoursIndicator.$comment: The source states no range, so none is asserted (D024).

PID.title: Participant ID
PID.$comment: Many-to-one link to participant.PID; that every PID exists there cannot be enforced across tables (D102). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).

PaidBNFCode.title: BNF code of the medicines dispensed, as reimbursed by NHSBSA

PaidBNFName.title: BNF name of the medicine dispensed, as reimbursed by NHSBSA

PaidDissallowedIndicator.title: Indicator showing whether or not the item was disallowed by NHSBSA i.e. dispensed but not reimbursed

PaidDrugStrength.title: Strength of the medicine dispensed, as reimbursed by NHSBSA

PaidFormulation.title: Formulation of the medicine dispensed, as reimbursed by NHSBSA
